entries.text: pg_mooncake tuning files now apply clustering and sorting, and the adapter claims `CLUSTERING` and `SORTING`. `CLUSTER` runs on the loaded heap table before `mooncake.create_table` mirrors it, so the mirror's Parquet files inherit the sort order; the intent is recorded as applied only after the mirror's files are read back and found ordered on the tuned columns. A partitioning request is rejected when the tuning file loads, because partitioning the source does not shape the mirror. A TPC-H profile is at `examples/tunings/pg-mooncake/tpch_tuned.yaml`.
